posts.text: Hope the duty cut helps fairchem. BusinessLine – 23 Sep 26 Centre cuts customs duty on sunflower, soybean and palm oils from September 24 The Centre has cut basic customs duty on crude and refined sunflower, soybean and palm oils, with the new rates effective from September 24.
